answer: Social Matters >> Clothing & Lifestyle Question ID: 36841 Country: India Title: Is it ok to wear the pant and shirt? Question: Is it ok to wear the pant and shirt? Answer ID: 36841 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 339/184/H=1433) If common Muslims wear such loose pant and shirt in which the contour of body parts are not exposed, then it is allowable. However it is not right to wear it for muqtada (religious leaders). Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
